styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating graphite dark studio panels and light grey or white studio panels, clean depth, no busy textures
styleLock.lightingSystem: crisp cool studio key from front-left with soft fill, controlled specular highlights on the product, soft contact shadow
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte dark studio floor and light grey stone pedestal blocks
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; Chinese in-image text wrapped in 「」, headline 28-48pt, label 10-14pt, short copy only

styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle, product centered or right-anchored, consistent scale across the set, each screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: consistent industrial electrical ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of graphite dark background #17181C, mist light grey #F2F4F6, pure white #FFFFFF, and one industrial yellow accent #F5C400; neutral temperature, crisp cool studio lighting; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with short copy; rounded dark info cards with thin-line white icons in dark circular chips; clean commercial product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 10 张 800×1200 切片拼读还原约九屏长图。主产品为透明外壳小型电磁中间继电器配 DIN 导轨插座，与源文件夹名「五金」不符，按 taxonomy 归入 家装灯具/电工（继电器属电工控制元件，非五金紧固件）。已剥离：源品牌名、具体型号及其解码表、EAC/CE 认证标、促销水印、全部原文案；文案与参数一律以 {selling_point}/{callout} 文案槽位重建，未验证的资质与数据一律不虚构，prompt 负向词禁止虚构认证与型号；产品一律以 {product} 占位。
